mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the INDPRO supply index signals stronger production capacity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05) when INDPRO is on an upward trend over the past 5 quarters.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate above 4% signals monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns positive despite FEDFUNDS crossing above 4%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in UNRATE above 8.5% and PAYEMS above 135,000 signals a tight labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE crosses above 8.5% AND PAYEMS crosses above 135,000
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns positive when both UNRATE and PAYEMS cross above their thresholds.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, a sustained decline in the federal funds rate below 2% signals monetary easing, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns not significantly positive (p>0.05) in late-cycle expansion when FEDFUNDS drops below 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in GDPC1 demand growth signals stronger economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05) when GDPC1 is on an upward trend over the past 5 quarters.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in UNRATE above 9% signals elevated inflation expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns positive despite UNRATE crossing above 9%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in GDPC1 above 12,000 and HOUST above 470 signals robust demand growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 crosses above 12,000 AND HOUST crosses above 470
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not positive when both GDPC1 and HOUST cross above their thresholds.

mechanism_narrative: In a post-shock recovery, a sustained increase in INDPRO above 105 signals improved production capacity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns not significantly positive (p>0.05) in post-shock recovery when INDPRO is above 105.
